attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Pharmacy (DC Health)

rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal.

topics.who: Cultural competency or specialized clinical training focused on LGBTQ patients
At least 10% of the total hours in subjects named by the Director as DC public health priorities
Immunization-certified pharmacists, to renew that certification
Immunization-certified pharmacists: current CPR to renew that certification

rules.notes: At least 10 of the 40 contact hours must be live. Immunization-certified pharmacists also need 2 h of immunization CE and current CPR to renew that certification (+$50). Renewal asks for the NABP e-Profile number. Licenses expire the last day of the birth month (odd/even year = birth year).
